sloka: त्वया नाथेन काकुत्स्थ न सनाथा वसुंधरा ।प्रमदा शील संपूर्णा पति एव च विधर्मिणा ॥४-१७-४२॥
transliteration: tvayā nāthena kākutstha na sanāthā vasuṁdharā ।pramadā śīla saṁpūrṇā pati eva ca vidharmiṇā ॥4-17-42॥

translations.english: 'You are treacherous, dishonest, mean, guised with false humility and a sinner to the core. How were you born to that highsouled Dasaratha?
